Stop.description: Logs session activity for recovery and tracking

Pushes all projects with new observations to Engram cloud on session stop. Idempotent + fail-open. Sin campo timeout: Claude Code no lo aplica a hooks async; los topes (60 s por llamada, 900 s total, candado) están dentro del script. See CLAUDE.md § Protocolos de guardado.
Línea de riesgo (solo registro): al cerrar un trabajo con cambios, anota si terminó con 'Riesgo:'. Log ~/.claude/logs/riesgo-line.jsonl, resumen con --report.

SessionStart.description: Loads previous session context on resume (additionalContext). Moved from Notification 2026-09-01: stderr there never reached the model.
Registers the Claude Code session in the local Engram server when the plugin could not (no jq / ambiguous cwd), so mem_save does not fail with unknown_session. Fail-open.
